# Swiper assets

Pinned version: 12.0.3 (MIT).

Sources:
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/swiper@12.0.3/swiper-bundle.min.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/swiper@12.0.3/swiper-bundle.min.css
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/swiper@12.0.3/LICENSE
- API reference: https://swiperjs.com/swiper-api

The browser bundle has a single local adapter appended: `export default Swiper;`.
This makes the self-contained bundle importable by the LMS JavaScript module without fetching separate module dependencies. The original copyright and license header is retained. All runtime assets are served locally.
